source.note: Candles are carried in this file because data/ is gitignored and a criterion that read the archive would pass only on the machine that downloaded it. Each window runs from the decision bar to the timeout horizon and stops there.

verification: Expectations were produced by a second implementation written from spec 52's prose rather than from research/labelling.py, and three of the twenty were checked by hand against the printed candle window. The working is in docs/build-log/phase-4/c-interface.md.
